title: Columbus reaches the Bahamas; conquest and enslavement begin
summary: Columbus's crews landed on Guanahani, home of the Lucayan people. He kidnapped Taíno on his first voyage, took over 1,500 Arawaks in February 1495, and sought profit from enslaving Hispaniola's Native people.
why: Began lasting contact, conquest and exchange of people, crops and diseases between the hemispheres.

notes.problem: Title framed the arrival as a neutral reunion ("two worlds reconnect"); omitted that Columbus took captives and enslaved Native people.
